transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Monitor updates stay empty. Status is declared supported, but no status family update is written.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: user.message starts a turn at interactionId. assistant.turn_start only records an internal id and emits no event.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: assistant.turn_end completes the interaction only when that internal turn was marked terminal, which happens when an assistant message had no tool requests. Otherwise the end emits nothing.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: abort and session.error fail the current interaction when one exists, and emit no turn event when none exists.
